products.title: Alsona
products.description: 95% of prospects aren't ready to buy when you reach out. Alsona finds the ones showing buying intent right now. It tracks 32+ signals across hiring, funding, tech changes, reviews, ad spend, and more, then scores companies against your ICP and explains why they're worth contacting. AI agents turn those signals into personalized LinkedIn and email outreach, helping you start conversations while the buying window is open. Alsona helps you book calls directly with the 5% who is ready to buy today.

products.title: Wanaka Studio
products.description: The first all-in-one, AI-native game engine. An AI agent builds your AAA-style 3D game. You can edit it directly in a synced visual editor. No code. Auto-rigging, multiplayer, and 1-click publish built in. Uses ~80% fewer tokens and generates faster than Claude Opus 5.5 + Unity.

products.title: Empacer
products.description: Most SMB owners face the same problem when trying to use AI tools: they don't have time for re-explaining their business in every chat. Empacer is designed to skip this part. Three questions at setup, then spoken requests become a ready plan and finished work: customer replies, social posts, invoices and more. Nothing is sent without the owner's approval.

products.title: Product Hunt MCP
products.description: Ask your AI assistant to find your next favorite product. Explore new launches, compare alternatives, and see what the Product Hunt community thinks. Building something yourself? Turn your README and website into a launch draft, add images, and check what's missing before you submit. Sign in with Product Hunt to connect. No API key needed.

products.title: Scalekit
products.description: Let your agents use 30,000+ tools across 600+ apps, from Salesforce to GitHub, through one MCP gateway. AgentKit handles auth and integrations, so every action runs as the user who asked, within the scopes they granted. Give each agent only the tools its job needs with Virtual MCP Servers. Add internal APIs as custom connectors. Use Triggers to start an agent the moment an email lands. Built for developers taking agents to production: every call is logged. Free tier: 10,000 tool calls a month.

products.title: /dev/null
products.description: /dev/null started as a live stream from the JetBrains office. On Oct 15, 2026, Nuno Maduro, Brent Roose, Matthieu Napoli, and Pauline Vos built a social network for web developers from scratch in 48 hours, in the open. Sign in with GitHub, share code snippets, like, reply, etc, etc! Hundreds of you sent PRs. Laravel’s Taylor Otwell stopped by mid-stream (“Laravel forever”), and Vercel’s Guillermo Rauch called it “really well done.” Thank you for watching, sharing, and roasting us.

market_deep_dive.headline: Anthropic's above-range IPO price lifts the bar for AI listings
market_deep_dive.summary: Anthropic reportedly priced its IPO at 83 dollars a share, above the expected range, for a 1.5 trillion dollar valuation. That caps a month of slipping expectations and sets a higher bar for other AI listings.

signals.label: Target cut from 2 trillion
signals.text: Early November reports said Anthropic aimed for 1.3 trillion dollars, down from 2 trillion, with later reports pointing to 1.4 trillion.

signals.label: Buyers expected less
signals.text: Days before pricing, buyers were said to see a valuation as low as 1.1 trillion dollars after a selloff in AI stocks.

signals.label: Final price beat range
signals.text: The company reportedly priced at 83 dollars a share, above its projected range, for 1.5 trillion dollars on a fully diluted basis.

impact.label: New listing benchmark
impact.text: Rival AI firms now face a higher bar, needing growth that justifies a 1.5 trillion dollar mark or accepting a discount from investors.

impact.label: Public buyers pay up
impact.text: Investors who receive shares pay above the expected range, leaving them less room for error if growth slows after the listing.

impact.label: Customers weigh cheaper tools
impact.text: Users on community forums describe cutting paid usage for cheaper models and complain about extra credit charges, a sign of price sensitivity.

outlook.label: Watch first public quarter
outlook.text: If the first public reports show steady revenue, more AI firms will likely try to list within the next year.

outlook.label: Capital follows the winner
outlook.text: A valuation that holds would pull more money into AI compute and talent, squeezing smaller firms that cannot match the spending.

outlook.label: Lockup expiry test
outlook.text: A share price below the offer once insiders can sell would reverse the read-across and chill the pipeline of AI listings.
